question: $x=\overline{C+B}(a+b c);x$ এর মান 1 হবে যখন—
explanation:
a=0, b = 0, c = 0 হলে,

$\begin{aligned} & x=\overline{c+b}(a+b c)=\overline{0+0}(0+0.0)=\overline{0}(0+0)=1.0=0 \\ & a=1, b=0, c=0 \text { হলে, } \\ & x=\overline{c+b}(a+b c)=\overline{0+0}(1+0.0)=\overline{0} \cdot 1=1.1=1 \\ & a=1, b=1, c=0 \text { হলে, } \\ & x=\overline{c+b}(a+b c)=\overline{0+1}(1+1.0)=\overline{1}(1+0)=0.1=0 \\ & a=0, b=1, c=1 \text { হলে, } \\ & x=\overline{c+b}(a+b c) \\ & =\overline{1+1}(0+1.1)=\overline{1}(0+1)=0.1=0 .\end{aligned}$

অর্থাৎ a = 1, b = 0, c = 0 হলে x এর মান 1 হবে।
